administrator_acceptance.decision: Follow the supplied V2 project plan, place it in the V2 development control state, and make it happen.

plan_revisions.title: Paired Continuity Overseer and Initial Project Orchestrator Bootstrap
plan_revisions.scope: Require paired Continuity Overseer and initial Project Orchestrator prompts at new-project acceptance or formal adoption into Floppy, both bound to the same project-origin record; preserve original project intent and accepted scope across orchestrator succession while allowing lawful administrator-approved revision.

governing_principle: Context loss is not authority to reconstruct accepted work.

trigger: new Floppy project accepted into controlled project operation
existing non-Floppy project formally adopted into Floppy

work_package_placement.V2-02: Define the user-facing trigger and onboarding/adoption handoff into paired continuity bootstrap without implementing V2-04 runtime behavior.
work_package_placement.V2-03: Protect project-origin, original-intent, accepted-scope, and accepted-plan records from silent reconstruction or drift.
work_package_placement.V2-04: Implement paired Continuity Overseer/initial Orchestrator bootstrap, durable linkage, and orchestrator succession.
work_package_placement.V2-05: Bind the Official Project Plan to the shared project origin and prove the paired bootstrap end to end.

work_packages.title: V2 Architecture and Compatibility Contract
work_packages.objective: Define the exact legal relationship between v1 and v2 before implementation begins.
work_packages.administrator_decision: ACCEPT V2-01 WORK-PACKAGE PROPOSAL AS THE PLANNING BASELINE.
acceptance_boundaries: No implementation ambiguity remains for V2-02 through V2-05.
No silent v1 state conversion is required.
No accepted v1 disposition is rewritten.
All proposed new state has an explicit owner and lifecycle role.
Exact version/schema compatibility rules are reviewable.

work_packages.title: User Onboarding and Provider-Independent Adoption
work_packages.objective: Make Floppy usable by a person who has never seen the system before and make that entry path independent of any single AI provider.
acceptance_boundaries: All maintained provider guides use the same canonical Floppy semantics.
Provider-specific access instructions do not create provider-specific authority rules.
Class A/B/C workflows are documented.
Existing-project preservation is explicit.
Onboarding never silently authorizes implementation.

New-project acceptance and formal Floppy adoption define a user-facing handoff in which the Continuity Overseer prompt and initial Project Orchestrator prompt are issued together from one shared project origin.
V2-02 defines the paired-bootstrap trigger and user-facing handoff without prematurely implementing V2-04 Continuity Overseer runtime or succession behavior.

work_packages.title: Accepted-State Continuity Protection
work_packages.objective: Prevent context loss, model replacement, or re-onboarding from silently destroying or reconstructing accepted state.
acceptance_boundaries: A fresh model can read protected accepted state.
Protected accepted state cannot be replaced without the lawful revision pathway.
Project-origin, original-intent, accepted-scope, and accepted-plan records are protected accepted state and may change only through the lawful revision/supersession pathway.

work_packages.title: Continuity Overseer and Orchestrator Succession
work_packages.objective: Add project-level continuity across project-orchestrator lifetimes, beginning with a paired Continuity Overseer and initial Project Orchestrator bootstrap from one project origin.
acceptance_boundaries: At new-project acceptance or formal adoption into Floppy, the Continuity Overseer prompt and initial Project Orchestrator prompt are generated or issued together as separate conversations bound to the same project-origin record.
The Continuity Overseer persists across Project Orchestrator replacements and preserves the original accepted project intent, accepted scope, exclusions, and constraints against silent drift.
Material change to the original project goal or fundamental scope is surfaced as an explicit administrator project-level revision rather than ordinary orchestrator drift.
Bounded orchestrator handoff succeeds without project restart.
Replacement orchestrators remain linked to the same Continuity Overseer and project-origin chain.
Accepted work is not recreated.
Authority does not change merely because the orchestrator changes.

work_packages.title: Official Project Plan, Integration, Compatibility Validation, and V2 Release
work_packages.objective: Complete the design-to-execution handoff capability, integrate all v2 additions, prove compatibility, and publish v2.0.0.
acceptance_boundaries: New-user end-to-end proof passes.
Existing-project proof passes.
Existing-v1-project compatibility/adoption proof passes.
Orchestrator-continuity proof passes.
Provider-independence proof passes.
The Official Project Plan and the paired Continuity Overseer/initial Project Orchestrator bootstrap are bound to the same accepted project origin.
End-to-end new-project and adoption proofs show both prompts issued together before orchestrated implementation begins.
v2.0.0 is released only from exact accepted final main.
